rows.note: Written: \Delta=\deleted{\unsure{9|4}}b^3-27c^2 with a question mark, as already represented in the LaTeX. The supplied mathematical refinement gives \prod_i f'(x_i)=4b^3+27c^2 for f=x^3+bx+c, and identifies b^3-27c^2 with disc(4x^3-bx-c)/16. An exact symbolic computation was performed in this run with SymPy 1.14.0: resultant(x^3+b*x+c,3*x^2+b,x)=4*b^3+27*c^2, and discriminant(4*x^3-b*x-c,x)/16=b^3-27*c^2. This verifies the refinement for the two specified cubic normalizations; it does not establish which normalization the author intended. The cited prior note was not consulted. Preserve the boxed written slip, deletion, and question mark; no LaTeX edit is made.
